description: Put an older version's masters back in the draft and approve them as a new version, so the history only grows. From anyone but an owner or admin, this asks the owner to approve instead. Send the draft's current draftRev: the draft is replaced. Costs no credits.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you make up for this call. Send the SAME one again after a lost answer to get the first answer back, with nothing spent twice.

name: restore_version
title: Bring back an older version
